# 🧨 Threat assessment

## Scope and assets
List system components, data assets, identities, secrets, and deployment boundaries.

## Assumptions and trust boundaries
Separate verified architecture from assumptions.

## Threat scenarios
| Threat | Actor | Entry point | Impact | Likelihood | Mitigation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| | | | | | |

## Abuse cases
Describe misuse of public data, UI controls, workflows, dependencies, or integrations.

## Existing controls
Link controls to code/workflows and provide verification evidence.

## Gaps and residual risks
Record unmitigated issues, owners, and due dates.

## Reassessment triggers
New data fields, API, authentication, storage, integrations, or hosting changes require review.
